subject: Time-restricted eating shows promise for type 1 diabetes blood sugar control
script: From Agewell Brief: Time-restricted eating shows promise for type 1 diabetes blood sugar control. A new UIC study suggests that time-restricted eating may help adults with type 1 diabetes manage glucose levels, but the findings are preliminary and require medical supervision. Type 1 diabetes is a relentless metabolic tightrope. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
